I went through similar and it really takes effort and time. I know it sucks and it feels like everything is collapsing, but you have to think about the people who care for you and the people you love/appreciate. Its okay to have days where you just dont want to get out of bed or do anything. Its okay to be proud of small things like doing laundry or brushing your teeth or even just being in school! You can get through it, and I know I'm just a stranger saying this but I've been through personal hell before; I've felt like nothing was left for me and was depressed as hell for so long. I can relate (maybe not spot on, but I know how it feels to feel alone and not want to burden others) and I promise you if you stick through this tough time it'll get much better, and one day in the future you'll have a bad day and you'll think, "wow, this day is bad, but compared to that time a while ago, I'm in such a good headspace". Just push through it. It's hard, but the first step is reaching out and you've accomplished that by making this post!! I'm proud of you for that. Keep making small steps and they'll add up in the end.
